messages:
Hiro: Postmortem follow-up reminder  we agreed to tighten rollouts after the regional degradation incident. Need owners, concrete deliverables, and short ETAs so we can close the action items.

Dana: I'll take the auto-rollback controller changes (policy enforcement + audit events). ETA: 2026-04-09 for a staging PR, 2026-04-16 for canary in prod. Blocker: signal stability on p95 compute in low-traffic regions.

Khalid: I'll own flag blast-radius controls and region scoping UI. Deliverables: proposal doc by 2026-03-28, schema PR by 2026-04-05.

Hiro: SRE requirements for rollback telemetry?

sre-bot: Rollback event must include route, variant_from, variant_to, reason, metric_snapshot, sample_size. Retain 90 days, index route+variant.

Dana: Plan for rollback event: `rollback.triggered` with fields above and a `trigger_type` enum (auto/manual). Will post schema to JIRA-7128.

Maya: I'll own canary success criteria and the dashboards. ETA: 2026-03-30 for the dashboard cards + composite alert (error_rate OR p95 regression).

Khalid: Sketch of flag gating (yaml):
```yaml
flag: new_inference_path
stages:
  - pct: 1
    regions: [us-east-1]
  - pct: 10
    regions: [us-east-1, eu-west-1]
safety:
  min_requests: 300
  auto_rollback: true
  max_blast_radius_pct: 5
```

Dana: Auto-rollback policy sketch (json):
```json
{ "policy": "auto_rollback", "min_requests": 250, "failure_rate_pct": 1.8, "p95_delta_ms": 50, "window_sec": 300 }
```

Maya: Acceptance: a stage is successful iff sample_size >= min_requests AND (error_rate < threshold AND p95 <= baseline + delta). If sample_size insufficient mark as "insufficient_data" and require human review.

Hiro: Action tracking: Dana -> JIRA-7128, Khalid -> JIRA-7129, Maya -> JIRA-7130. Put ETA and PR links in each ticket. I'll review progress weekly.

Khalid: Will add UI toggle to disable auto-rollback during maintenance windows (audit log required).

sre-bot: Deploy window: 2026-04-10 02:00-04:00 UTC. Add `pre-deploy-checklist` to PRs.

Dana: Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/3010 (WIP). Needs schema signoff.

Maya: Dashboards added to JIRA-7130. Composite alert named `canary-stage-failure`.

Hiro: Good. Please drop PR links here when ready. If anyone misses ETA, escalate to leads and update the ticket. Closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:

Product Ops: Reminder  include who runs the first 3 canaries and who owns post-rollback triage in the ticket descriptions.
